processing_steps.method: vacuum induction melting + vacuum arc remelting (VIM + VAR), followed by forging
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Both materials produced by VIM + VAR into 500 kg ingots, subsequently forged into billets with Φ170 mm; characterization specimens extracted from the quarter-radius position.
Solution treatment was performed to dissolve carbides; the resulting as-quenched condition is denoted 1.3Al,WQ.
Water quenching after solution treatment produces the as-quenched (1.3Al,WQ) condition.

structures.overall_structure: Martensitic structure in the as-quenched (water-quenched) condition. The 1.3Al steel is a low alloy ultrahigh strength martensitic steel; the as-quenched condition (prior to tempering) is denoted 1.3Al,WQ.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: Tensile: diameter 5 mm, gauge length 25 mm; Charpy U-notch: 10 × 10 × 55 mm^3
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Three tests per sample condition were performed; specimen surfaces and notches mechanically polished.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Specimens cut from impact specimens, ground, polished, etched with a 4 vol% nitric acid-ethanol solution
characterization_methods.key_findings: SEM was used to characterize the lath/plate martensitic microstructure (reported for the 1.3Al steel).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Thin foils ground to 50 μm, punched into Φ3 mm discs, electropolished by double-jet thinning at 30 V and -25 °C using a 10 vol% perchloric acid alcohol solution
characterization_methods.purpose: Characterization of martensite, retained austenite and ε-carbides
characterization_methods.key_findings: TEM used to characterize lath martensite, retained austenite films at lath boundaries and needle-like ε-carbides (reported for the 1.3Al steel).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Bruker e-Flash FS detector mounted on the SEM; 20 kV; step size 0.1 μm
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Specimens 10 × 10 × 5 mm^3, mechanically polished with 0.02 μm colloidal silica suspension; data processed with Aztec Crystal v2.1
characterization_methods.purpose: Measurement of multilevel martensitic structures (prior austenite grains, packets, blocks) and KAM analysis
characterization_methods.key_findings: EBSD used to measure prior austenite grain, packet and block sizes and local strain (KAM) distribution (reported for the 1.3Al steel).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku D/Max-2550, Co radiation source operated at 40 kV and 150 mA
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Scans from 20° to 110° at a scanning rate of 2°/min
characterization_methods.purpose: Phase analysis and determination of retained austenite content and dislocation density
characterization_methods.key_findings: XRD used for phase analysis; retained austenite and dislocation density determined by the direct-comparison and Williamson-Hall methods (reported for the 1.3Al steel).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Base temperature 50 K, pulse fraction 0.2, repetition rate 125 kHz, detection rate ~5 ions per 1 k pulses; reconstructed with CAMECA IVAS 3.6.8
characterization_methods.purpose: Characterization of nanoscale ε-carbides and NiAl clusters
characterization_methods.key_findings: APT used to resolve ε-carbides and NiAl clusters and their compositions (reported for the 1.3Al steel, tempered state).

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Diameter 5 mm, gauge length 25 mm, strain rate 0.001 s^-1
characterization_methods.purpose: Measurement of yield strength, ultimate tensile strength and total elongation
characterization_methods.key_findings: 1.3Al steel in the as-quenched (WQ) condition: YS 1113 ± 11 MPa, UTS 2145 ± 144 MPa, TE 4.3 ± 0.9 %.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Specimens 10 × 10 × 55 mm^3; surfaces and notches mechanically polished; three tests per condition
characterization_methods.key_findings: 1.3Al steel in the as-quenched (WQ) condition: KU2 = 23 ± 2 J.

characterization_methods.technique: Plane strain fracture toughness test (three-point bending)
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Thickness 25 mm, width 50 mm, 3 mm fatigue pre-crack at notch tip, loading rate 38 KN/min; KQ per ASTM E399
characterization_methods.purpose: Determination of conditional fracture toughness KQ
characterization_methods.key_findings: KQ/KIC reported only for the tempered condition (1.3Al,2 h = 108.0 MPa·m^1/2); no toughness value reported for the as-quenched (WQ) condition.

computational_details.simulation_method: Williamson-Hall analysis of XRD peak broadening

analytical_models.equation_role: Estimate apparent crystallite size (D) and lattice strain (ε) from XRD line broadening
Compute dislocation density from crystallite size and lattice strain

computational_details.simulation_method: Conditional fracture toughness calculation per ASTM E399

analytical_models.equation_role: Calculate KQ from load and specimen geometry

unmapped_findings: Charpy U-notch impact absorbing energy (KU2) of the 1.3Al steel in the as-quenched (WQ) condition was 23 ± 2 J (Table 2 and Fig. 1(b)); there is no dedicated impact-toughness slot in the property schema, so it is recorded here. Source: b0035, b0039, figure_001, figure_002.

The 1.3Al steel fractured prior to reaching its maximum tensile strength during the room-temperature tensile test in the as-quenched (1.3Al,WQ) condition, with a total elongation of 4.3 ± 0.9 %. Source: b0034.

No fracture toughness (KIC/KQ) value was reported for the as-quenched (WQ) condition; the mechanical property table lists a dash for WQ while KIC is given only for the 2 h tempered conditions (0Al,2 h = 97.6 MPa·m^1/2; 1.3Al,2 h = 108.0 MPa·m^1/2). Source: b0039, figure_002.

The microstructural data quantified in the paper (retained austenite contents of 1.8 % for 1.3Al and 1.0 % for 0Al, dislocation densities of ~2.20 × 10^15 m^-2 for 1.3Al and ~2.01 × 10^15 m^-2 for 0Al, needle-like ε-carbides 100–500 nm long/2–4 nm thick, and coherent B2-NiAl clusters with number density 4.88 × 10^24 m^-3 and equivalent radius 0.57 nm) are reported for the tempered condition, not for the as-quenched (WQ) sample, and are therefore not attributed to this sample. Source: b0042, b0052, b0069.
